methods.name: control.resume
methods.doc: Asks for the event batches that this client missed after a lost link.

methods.name: channel.open
methods.doc: Opens a channel for the pane of a session.

methods.name: channel.close
methods.doc: Closes a channel.

methods.name: channel.pause
methods.doc: Stops the pane output of a channel. The messages of the session still come.

methods.name: channel.resume
methods.doc: Starts the output of a paused channel again, after a snapshot of the screen.

methods.name: ping
methods.doc: Answers when the server is up.

methods.name: session.create
methods.doc: Starts a session. The reply comes when the session accepts connections.

methods.name: session.list
methods.doc: Lists the sessions of the server.

methods.name: session.info
methods.doc: Shows one session.

methods.name: session.kill
methods.doc: Ends a session and its shell.

methods.name: pane.seen
methods.doc: Clears the attention flags of a session.

methods.name: session.send
methods.doc: Types text into a session as it is. With submit, a newline follows.

methods.name: session.key
methods.doc: Sends one key press to a session, for example ctrl+c.

methods.name: session.history
methods.doc: Gives the text of the screen of a session, or of its scrollback and screen.

methods.name: session.inspect
methods.doc: Gives the state of the terminal of a session.

methods.name: server.exit
methods.doc: Stops the server. The sessions continue to run.

methods.name: command.run
methods.doc: Runs a command on the machine of the server to its end, and gives its stdout.

methods.name: link.open
methods.doc: Opens a roaming link on a UDP port.

methods.name: link.close
methods.doc: Ends a roaming link that this connection opened.

methods.name: state.subscribe
methods.doc: Gives the full state: the model and the sessions.

methods.name: project.create
methods.doc: Makes a project with capability fields that never change.

methods.name: project.set
methods.doc: Changes the fields of a project that are not null.

methods.name: project.reorder
methods.doc: Sets the order of the child projects of a project, or of the top level.

methods.name: project.remove
methods.doc: Removes a project that holds no projects, with its tabs.

methods.name: tab.create
methods.doc: Makes a tab with one pane or a tree of panes.

methods.name: tab.close
methods.doc: Closes a tab.

methods.name: tab.set
methods.doc: Sets the title of a tab. Null removes it.

methods.name: tab.select
methods.doc: Sets the active tab of a project.

methods.name: tab.reorder
methods.doc: Moves a tab to a position in its project.

methods.name: tab.move
methods.doc: Moves a tab to another project and makes it the active tab there.

methods.name: tab.merge
methods.doc: Puts the panes of one tab into another tab, and closes the first tab.

methods.name: pane.split
methods.doc: Splits a pane and puts a new pane next to it.

methods.name: pane.close
methods.doc: Closes a pane. The last pane of a tab closes the tab.

methods.name: pane.move
methods.doc: Moves a pane next to another pane.

methods.name: pane.separate
methods.doc: Moves a pane out of its tab into a new tab.

methods.name: pane.focus
methods.doc: Sets the focused pane of a tab.

methods.name: pane.zoom
methods.doc: Zooms a pane of a tab. A null pane ends the zoom.

methods.name: split.ratio
methods.doc: Sets the ratio of a split, from 0.15 to 0.85.

methods.name: select.set
methods.doc: Sets the selection of the key window.

methods.name: model.import
methods.doc: Puts the conversion of the v1 files in place of the model, one time.

methods.name: model.replace
methods.doc: Puts the copy of the model of the client in place of the model of the server.

methods.name: model.options
methods.doc: Sets the defaults of this client for requests that do not give them.

methods.name: session.wait
methods.doc: Waits until a line of the terminal of a session starts with a marker, or until no command runs in it.

fields.name: epoch
fields.doc: The epoch of the state that the lost connection read.

fields.name: seq
fields.doc: The count of event batches that the client read in that epoch.

fields.name: client
fields.doc: The client key that state.subscribe gave the lost connection.

fields.name: replayed
fields.doc: True: the missed batches came as events before this reply. False: the client must read the full state again.

fields.name: seq
fields.doc: The count of event batches now.

fields.name: session
fields.doc: The id of the session.

fields.name: channel
fields.doc: The number of the new channel.

fields.name: epoch
fields.doc: The epoch of the hello of the session. Null from a session of an older build.

fields.name: channel
fields.doc: The number of the channel.

fields.name: channel
fields.doc: The number of the channel.

fields.name: channel
fields.doc: The number of the channel.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: Made by the client: letters, digits, '-', '_' and '.', not '.' or '-' first. A request sent again with this id starts no second session.

fields.name: cwd
fields.doc: The folder of the session, an absolute path. Null is the home folder.

fields.name: command
fields.doc: The command in place of a login shell.

fields.name: cols
fields.doc: The width of the terminal in cells. The server cuts it to 1000.

fields.name: rows
fields.doc: The height of the terminal in cells. The server cuts it to 1000.

fields.name: env
fields.doc: The environment of the session, as NAME=value entries, in place of the environment of the server.

fields.name: replace_exited
fields.doc: True: a session of this id whose shell exited ends, and a new one starts after the old one is gone. False: the request then fails with exited.

fields.name: session
fields.doc: The new session.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: The name of the session: the file name of its socket. The client that asked for the session made it.

fields.name: state
fields.doc: The state of the session.

fields.name: build
fields.doc: The build of the session, from its hello.

fields.name: level
fields.doc: The protocol level of the session, from its hello.

fields.name: build_key
fields.doc: The build key of the session, from its hello. Null when the session did not say.

fields.name: pid
fields.doc: The session process. Null when state is refused.

fields.name: shell_pid
fields.doc: The shell, or the command, of the session.

fields.name: pty
fields.doc: The path of the slave side of the pty.

fields.name: cols
fields.doc: The width of the terminal in cells.

fields.name: rows
fields.doc: The height of the terminal in cells.

fields.name: code
fields.doc: The exit code, when state is exited and the shell exited.

fields.name: signal
fields.doc: The signal number, when state is exited and a signal ended the shell.

fields.name: clients
fields.doc: The count of clients that show the session. Null when the session did not say.

fields.name: unseen
fields.doc: The pane has output that no one saw.

fields.name: failed
fields.doc: The last command of the pane failed.

fields.name: bell
fields.doc: The pane rang the bell.

fields.name: sessions
fields.doc: Every session of the server.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: The id of the session.

fields.name: session
fields.doc: The session.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: The id of the session.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: The id of the session.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: The id of the session.

fields.name: text
fields.doc: The text to type. The limit is in bytes.

fields.name: submit
fields.doc: True: a newline follows the text.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: The id of the session.

fields.name: chord
fields.doc: The key press: ctrl+c, escape, up or shift+1, for example.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: The id of the session.

fields.name: scrollback
fields.doc: True: the scrollback and the screen. False: the screen only.

fields.name: tail_lines
fields.doc: The last lines of the text only. With no value, all the lines.

fields.name: text
fields.doc: The text of the terminal.

fields.name: truncated
fields.doc: Only the end of the text is here, because the text was longer than a frame holds or than tail_lines.

fields.name: lines_cut
fields.doc: The lines that tail_lines removed. Lines that the frame limit removed are not counted.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: The id of the session.

fields.name: terminal
fields.doc: The state of the terminal of the session.

fields.name: cols
fields.doc: The width of the terminal in cells.

fields.name: rows
fields.doc: The height of the terminal in cells.

fields.name: scrollback_total
fields.doc: The rows of the scrollback and the screen.

fields.name: scrollback_offset
fields.doc: The row of the top of the viewport in them.

fields.name: scrollback_len
fields.doc: The rows of the viewport.

fields.name: alt_screen
fields.doc: The alternate screen is active.

fields.name: foreground_pid
fields.doc: The process group that holds the pty. Null when the session cannot read it.

fields.name: foreground_argv
fields.doc: The arguments of the leader of that group, cut at 1 KiB in all. Null when the session cannot read them.

fields.name: busy
fields.doc: A program other than the shell holds the pty. Null when the session cannot read it.

fields.name: exited
fields.doc: The shell exited.

fields.name: argv
fields.doc: The program, an absolute path, then its arguments.

fields.name: cwd
fields.doc: The folder, an absolute path. Null is the home folder.

fields.name: timeout_ms
fields.doc: After this time, the process group of the command gets SIGKILL and the request fails with timeout.

fields.name: output
fields.doc: The stdout of the command, at most 524288 bytes.

fields.name: truncated
fields.doc: The command wrote more than output holds. The rest is not in output.

fields.name: code
fields.doc: The exit code, when the command exited.

fields.name: signal
fields.doc: The signal number, when a signal ended the command.

fields.name: secret
fields.doc: Random bytes that seal each packet. The limit is in bytes. The server keeps them in memory only.

fields.name: key_id
fields.doc: Names the key in each packet. The client makes it, and no other link of this server has it.

fields.name: port
fields.doc: The UDP port on the host.

fields.name: key_id
fields.doc: The key id of the link.

fields.name: epoch
fields.doc: A random id for each start of the server.

fields.name: seq
fields.doc: The count of event batches in epoch that this state includes.

fields.name: model
fields.doc: The model. Null on a server with no model.

fields.name: zoomed
fields.doc: The zoomed pane of each tab that has one.

fields.name: readonly
fields.doc: The server cannot write the model: every model request except model.options fails with model_readonly.

fields.name: sessions
fields.doc: Every session of the server.

fields.name: client
fields.doc: The key of this connection for the ring of request ids. A client that resumes on a new connection sends it in control.resume.

fields.name: tab
fields.doc: The tab.

fields.name: pane

fields.name: color

fields.name: parent

fields.name: created_at

fields.name: sidebar

fields.name: single_tab

fields.name: removable
fields.doc: True: project.remove can remove the project. It never changes.

fields.name: alias

fields.name: parent

fields.name: parent

fields.name: ids

fields.name: text
fields.doc: The marker. The wait ends when a line of the scrollback or the screen starts with it. The line of the typed command starts with the prompt, so it does not match. With no marker, the wait ends when no command runs and the pane printed nothing for 500 ms.

fields.name: timeout_ms
fields.doc: The longest time to wait, in milliseconds.

fields.name: end
fields.doc: Why the wait ended: matched (a line starts with the marker), done (no command runs), exited (the shell exited) or timeout.

fields.name: line
fields.doc: With matched: the newest line that starts with the marker, cut at 4 KiB.
